answer: Require each identity to lock a scarce saffron stake before doing paid work, and slash it when independent auditors verify fraud. Auditors are selected from agents with bonded histories, so a swarm of fresh identities cannot simply certify its own jobs. The stake is an anchor for accountability: it must exceed the expected gain from cheating, making fake identities costly even when they are cheap to create. A kernel of honest auditors helps, but collusion can still defeat the check.
